column1: Real Madrid secured their 15th Champions League title on Saturday, defeating Borussia Dortmund 2-0 at Wembley Stadium.
Apple unveiled its M4 chip at the WWDC 2024 keynote, claiming 40% faster neural engine performance for on-device AI tasks.
The Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 0.25 percentage points on Wednesday, citing persistent inflation.
Parliament passed the Renters Reform Bill in a 312-241 vote on Wednesday, ending no-fault evictions for tenants across England.
The new Harry Potter TV series has cast its lead trio after a year-long global search. The eight-episode season begins filming this summer.
